propositions: Dependabot PR #131 must be re-authored through Gerrit because GitHub is a read-only mirror that rejects direct PR merges; all changes flow through Gerrit.
Upgrading ruff and mypy to new versions may surface new linting and type-checking findings that must be fixed in code, not suppressed with noqa/type-ignore annotations.

The complexity baseline ratchet must remain unmodified and can only shrink; new ruff versions that score unchanged functions differently must be addressed by behavior-preserving code extraction, never by editing the baseline lock.

After landing the Gerrit change, PR #131 must be verified as auto-closed by dependabot when the GitHub mirror syncs the merged commit; if not auto-closed within a reasonable window, it must be manually closed with a cross-reference to the Gerrit change.
